comment: Dental programs for Dental > Practice Management and Imaging. Public info is marked (confirm) until MAV checks it. No client names, passwords or license keys here (public repo).

programs.name: Open Dental
programs.about: On-site server runs MySQL/MariaDB. Each workstation runs the Open Dental client, which reads FreeDentalConfig.xml to find the server, and saves images to the shared A to Z folder.
programs.note: All Open Dental details confirmed by MAV.

fixes.label: Test connection to the server
fixes.cmd: Test-NetConnection <server> -Port 3306
fixes.info: Checks this PC can reach the Open Dental database on the server.

fixes.label: Point this PC at the server
fixes.cmd: FreeDentalConfig.xml: ComputerName = <server>
fixes.info: Sets the server name in FreeDentalConfig.xml so the client opens the right database. Keeps a backup of the old file.

fixes.label: Check the data share
fixes.cmd: Test-Path \\<server>\<share>; write test
fixes.info: Opens the share and writes a small test file, then deletes it. Fixes images or documents that will not open or save.

fixes.label: Install or update from the server
fixes.cmd: Find the workstation setup on \\<server>\<share> and start it
fixes.info: Looks for the Open Dental workstation setup on the server share and starts it. If it cannot pick one, it opens the share so you can choose.

fixes.label: Allow Open Dental through Windows Firewall
fixes.cmd: Allow the programs in the client folder (Domain, Private)
fixes.info: Adds Windows Firewall rules for the Open Dental programs on this PC.

programs.name: Eaglesoft

fixes.label: Test connection to the server

programs.name: DEXIS 9

fixes.label: Check the data share
fixes.cmd: Test-Path \\<server>\<share>; write test
fixes.info: Opens the share and writes a small test file, then deletes it. Fixes images or documents that will not open or save.

fixes.label: Reset the sensor (USB)
fixes.cmd: Disable and re-enable the sensor, then rescan devices
fixes.info: For a sensor that stopped responding or shows an error in Device Manager. Plug the sensor in first.

fixes.label: Stop USB power saving for sensors
fixes.cmd: Selective suspend off; USB hubs stay powered
fixes.info: Stops Windows from cutting power to the sensor between exposures. Fixes sensors that drop out or show as not found.

fixes.label: Fix DEXIS folder permissions
fixes.cmd: icacls C:\DEXIS /grant Users:(OI)(CI)M
fixes.info: Lets non-admin users write to C:\DEXIS.

fixes.cmd: Find the workstation setup on \\<server>\<share> and start it
fixes.info: Looks for the DEXIS 9 workstation setup on the server share and starts it. If it cannot pick one, it opens the share so you can choose.
